conclusion: No blocking issue found in reviewed nested tree/default-flat/indexed-URL paths. Does not establish device graphics/audio or whole-game native operation.
findings: Explicit registry-matched policy is the only joystick opt-in; old CLI default remains flat and APK below 10000000 bytes.
asset_tree retains all nested relative names; fullmatch ASCII, reserved components, path/depth/node/file limits, symlink and casefold file/directory collision checks apply.
asset_inputs rejects reserved/generated roots and aliases across host/game trees; payload index enumerates exact complete asset paths and is bounded at 65536 bytes.
Android resource access requires exact unencoded URL path present in bundled index, fixed origin, no query/fragment, and explicit MIME.
Complete nested dist source bytes enter existing android-build sources(), and staged/payload asset contents are subsequently compared by existing build manifest checks.
